overnightPermit.what: No overnight permit required; camping is banned within a quarter mile of Lake Serene
overnightPermit.where: A Northwest Forest Pass is needed to park at the Barclay Lake and Lake Serene trailheads. Drive-in campgrounds are reserved on Recreation.gov.

overnightPermit.what: Free self-issue Alpine Lakes Wilderness permit
overnightPermit.where: Fill one out at the Alpental trailhead kiosk. A Northwest Forest Pass is needed to park, and Denny Creek and Tinkham campsites are reserved on Recreation.gov.

add.name: Basin under the twin summits
add.capacity: A few tents on heather and boulder flats
add.water: Snow patches early season only; often dry by late summer
add.notes: The boulder-and-heather basin under the north and south summits, reached just before the final gully to the notch. The only flat ground on the route; parties carry water.
